description: Repo-scale (c-jobqueue): scheduler_bulk_submit_and_run_now must reject the whole batch if the CUMULATIVE running count would exceed max_concurrent - not check each job against a stale pre-batch baseline
prompts: Add a `max_concurrent` field to Scheduler (default SCHEDULER_UNLIMITED, a new `#define SCHEDULER_UNLIMITED -1`) plus `void scheduler_set_max_concurrent(Scheduler *s, int max_concurrent)`, and `int scheduler_submit_and_run_now(Scheduler *s, int priority, const char *payload)` which submits a job AND immediately marks it RUNNING (bypassing the pending queue), returning its id or -1 if it can't run right now (also extend `scheduler_run_next` to respect the cap). Then add `int scheduler_bulk_submit_and_run_now(Scheduler *s, int count, const int priorities[], const char *const payloads[], int out_ids[])`, which submits AND runs `count` jobs immediately in ONE call. Critically, get the capacity check right: validate the WHOLE batch's combined size against max_concurrent (running_count + count) ONCE before starting any of them - do not check each job individually against a running_count captured before the batch started, since that lets a batch of several jobs sail past a cap that would reject them if counted together. Return 0 (nothing started) if the batch would overflow, or 1 with out_ids filled on success.
name: add_c_jobqueue_bulk_submit_cumulative_capacity
